text: RPS (rps): Motor speed in revolutions per second

This dataset contains both Model-Agnostic and Model-Dependent variables. If you wish to test alternative propulsion models or aero-propulsive couplings, you MUST use the Model-Agnostic variables (e.g., motor speed (RPS), airspeed (Va_EKF_CG), battery_power, CG accelerations (ax_cg, p_dot)) to calculate your own thrust and torque.

Do NOT use the pre-calculated aerodynamic coefficients (CX, CY, CZ, Cl, Cm, Cn, CD, CS, CL) or the battery-derived drag power (P_drag_batt), as these were explicitly derived using the Skywalker X8's specific propeller and powertrain efficiency parameters defined by the original authors.
